items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I can think of names like George Johnson, who turned out to be Eddie Jefferson's protege, and who never ceases to give me credit for having been responsible for that

ctx.x: I had a beautiful experience in a club that Bill Harris, the guitarist that was with the group called The Clovers for quite a long time, as a matter of fact, the extent of their career... Bill Harris opened a club here, and he called it the Pig Foot. I was asked to come in and be musical director for the club, or officiate the entertainment. We started a workshop there. I met a lot of fine, young, up-and-coming, talented musicians. Some of them are really well on their way to making their mark. Others are still…

I can think of names like George Johnson, who turned out to be Eddie Jefferson's protege, and who never ceases to give me credit for having been responsible for that... Eddie Jefferson, the singer, who had such an untimely death... The singer that was with James Moody of "Moody's Mood For Love" fame, who was a very good friend of mine. And George Johnson seems to think that I had a lot to do with their relationship. Which he and Eddie became very good friends, and a a result of it, he met James Moody, and now he…
There are other people. There's a singer, Rod Willoughby, who is well on the way to becoming a very popular singer, and I am looking for big things from him.
